description: This file contains utility functions for managing spend tracking logs within the Litellm proxy project, including metadata handling, hashing, response ID generation, sanitization, and logging payload creation.

methods.name: bool _is_master_key(api_key: str, _master_key: Optional[str])
methods.description: Checks if the provided API key matches the master key via direct comparison or hash comparison.

methods.name: SpendLogsMetadata _get_spend_logs_metadata( metadata: Optional[dict], applied_guardrails: Optional[List[str]] = None, batch_models: Optional[List[str]] = None, mcp_tool_call_metadata: Optional[StandardLoggingMCPToolCall] = None, vector_store_request_metadata: Optional[ List[StandardLoggingVectorStoreRequest] ] = None, guardrail_information: Optional[List[StandardLoggingGuardrailInformation]] = None, usage_object: Optional[dict] = None, model_map_information: Optional[StandardLoggingModelInformation] = None, cold_storage_object_key: Optional[str] = None, litellm_overhead_time_ms: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs a SpendLogsMetadata object with provided metadata and optional related information, filtering keys accordingly.

methods.name: str generate_hash_from_response(response_obj: Any)
methods.description: Creates a stable MD5 hash string from a response object, serializing it with sorted keys.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_spend_logs_id( call_type: str, response_obj: dict, kwargs: dict )
methods.description: Generates an ID for spend logs based on call type and response contents, either by hashing or by response 'id'.

methods.name: dict _extract_usage_for_ocr_call(response_obj: Any, response_obj_dict: dict)
methods.description: Extracts usage metrics from OCR/AOCR responses, accommodating pages processed instead of tokens.

methods.name: SpendLogsPayload get_logging_payload( kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time )
methods.description: Creates a detailed spend logs payload from request and response data, handling metadata, usage, sanitization, and ID generation.

methods.name: str _get_session_id_for_spend_log( kwargs: dict, standard_logging_payload: Optional[StandardLoggingPayload], )
methods.description: Determines a session ID for the spend log, prioritizing trace_id, litellm_trace_id, or generating a new UUID.

methods.name: datetime _ensure_datetime_utc(timestamp: datetime)
methods.description: Converts a datetime object to UTC timezone.

methods.name: get_spend_by_team_and_customer( start_date: dt, end_date: dt, team_id: str, customer_id: str, prisma_client: PrismaClient, )
methods.description: Executes a raw SQL query using Prisma client to fetch aggregated spend and token data by team and customer within a date range.

methods.name: str _get_messages_for_spend_logs_payload( standard_logging_payload: Optional[StandardLoggingPayload], metadata: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Returns a string representation of request messages (stub implementation).

methods.name: dict _sanitize_request_body_for_spend_logs_payload( request_body: dict, visited: Optional[set] = None, )
methods.description: Recursively truncates long strings in request bodies to avoid large log entries, appending a skip message for truncated parts.

methods.name: str _get_proxy_server_request_for_spend_logs_payload( metadata: dict, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Serializes proxy server request body if permitted by configuration and sanitizes it.

methods.name: Optional[List[StandardLoggingVectorStoreRequest]] _get_vector_store_request_for_spend_logs_payload( vector_store_request_metadata: Optional[List[StandardLoggingVectorStoreRequest]], )
methods.description: Scrubs content from vector store request metadata if storing prompts/responses is disabled.

methods.name: str _get_response_for_spend_logs_payload( payload: Optional[StandardLoggingPayload], )
methods.description: Returns sanitized response string for the payload depending on config and payload contents.

methods.name: bool _should_store_prompts_and_responses_in_spend_logs()
methods.description: Determines if prompt/response data should be stored, based on configuration and secrets.

methods.name: Literal["success","failure"] _get_status_for_spend_log( metadata: dict, )
methods.description: Returns 'success' or 'failure' based on the metadata status.
